modeled_features: Official GIS polygon used for parking deck/floor plate outlines.

Six deck levels modeled at 2.85 m spacing, yielding approximately 15.06 m total height including the base and parapet; the floor count comes from GIS while exact spacing is an architectural inference, cross-checked against but not claimed to measure the ambiguous 47 extrusion field.
Open-air facade with shadowed ventilation openings, light concrete spandrel bands, red-brown brick piers, and glazed core slots based on CE Solutions photo.

Regular interior support grid, representative parking marks, four stair/elevator cores, and paired ramp runs are generalized/inferred because no verified PGU plans were accessible. They are not an asserted exact parking layout or verified accessible route.
Procedural concrete/traffic coating shaders; no external image dependencies.
remaining_uncertainty: No verified garage floorplan or measured elevation was found; interior circulation and bay layout are illustrative.
Exact floor-to-floor heights and roof construction are uncertain; modeled height is approximately 15.06 m.
GIS attribute source units for Shape__Area, Extrution, and floor elevation fields are not explicit.
Street-facing access positions were placed approximately using the photo and address context; exact present-day entrance configuration requires direct close-up survey or current imagery.
